**Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling (BUA)** is a specialized child and adolescent psychiatric department that operates as part of [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]] [^src1]. Located in the Central Jutland region (Midtjylland), the department functions as a central clinical reference center for the assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and youth [^src1]. 

The department's clinical work and staffing are highlighted in the national ADHD database annual reports for 2023 and 2024, which assess the quality of psychiatric care and map systemic challenges across Denmark [^src1] [^src2]. BUA employs several key medical specialists involved in these regional efforts. Notably, [[shelagh-powell|Shelagh Powell]] is employed at BUA as a Senior Physician (Overlæge) in Team 2 for school child psychiatry [^src1] [^src2]. Additionally, [[simon-hjerrild|Simon Hjerrild]], a Senior Physician, Clinical Lecturer, and PhD, is associated with the hospital's psychiatry department and the regional ADHD team in Central Jutland [^src1] [^src2]. 

Through its staff and institutional role, BUA is situated within the broader systemic challenges identified in the national reports, such as rising wait times, regional disparities in treatment pathways, and structural barriers in measuring healthcare quality in Region Midtjylland [^src1] [^src2].
